program.launch:
state.quiet_until = data.time + state.suppression_duration
if name == state.source_name:
    d = dof(model, state.source_name)
    state.pending_copies.append((data.time + state.copy_delay, data.qvel[d:d+3].copy()))
program.step:
if data.time >= state.quiet_until:
    bid = model.body(state.source_name).id
    data.xfrc_applied[bid, 1] += state.drift_acceleration * float(model.body_mass[bid])
due = [v for t, v in state.pending_copies if t <= data.time]
if due:
    state.pending_copies = [(t, v) for t, v in state.pending_copies if t > data.time]
    d = dof(model, state.recipient_name)
    data.qvel[d:d+3] = due[-1]
